educational_lesson.method: Treat report freshness at the field/event level. Retrieval today does not make a blank table a completed final report. Use the dated team article/transcript to resolve coverage gaps, retain the discrepancy, and do not promote a questionable tag or expected participation into confirmed active status.

testable_improvement.hypothesis: A final-report completeness check reduces erroneous unknown/cleared classifications relative to relying only on a generic injury URL.
testable_improvement.test: Freeze timestamped generic-table and dated-report observations before lineup cutoff; compare status error rates against the actual official final designation, preserving blank fields and conflicts. Evaluate game-day active status separately; do not judge injury classification by fantasy points.
testable_improvement.failure_condition: No adoption if the check increases stale-event substitution or gives no held-out error reduction.

source_access_limitations: Article/table text reviewed; no video playback.
No fresh authenticated league-state refresh performed.
No new FantasyPros API call or failed-pilot data used.
notification: Routine educational handoff; no claim of breaking news or an executable league action.

findings.text: Saints dated Friday report lists Kamara and Olave QUESTIONABLE, each limited Friday. The generic Saints table still has blank Friday/game fields at retrieval. The dated report resolves missing coverage, not a new Sunday downgrade.
Browns table remains Judkins QUESTIONABLE and Sampson OUT; Ravens side lists Andrews without designation and Jackson OUT. These confirm existing status context rather than new actionable changes.
findings.confidence: HIGH for table; game-day actives not established

findings.text: Kendre Miller opportunity requires separate Kamara-active and Kamara-inactive scenarios. A questionable tag does not specify absence probability, and absence would not justify allocating all missing touches to one backup.
findings.confidence: Scenario structure justified; numerical weights unavailable
